subtitle: Smart TV remote & app launcher
promotionalText: New: scenes, a sleep timer and Siri volume control. Free to download for VIZIO, Roku, Samsung, LG and Google TV; Pro adds every TV, typing and your PC.
description:
Couch Remote turns your iPhone into a fast, simple remote for the smart TVs in your home, and your Windows PC too. Free to download, with no ads and no tracking.

WORKS WITH
• VIZIO SmartCast TVs (2016 and newer)
• Roku TVs and Roku players: TCL, Hisense, onn., Sharp and Insignia Roku TVs, plus every Roku stick and box
• Samsung Smart TVs (Tizen, 2016 and newer)
• LG Smart TVs (webOS, 2014 and newer)
• Google TV and Android TV: Sony, TCL and Hisense Google TV, Philips Android TV, Chromecast with Google TV, Nvidia Shield
Your phone and TV must be on the same Wi-Fi.
Doesn't work with: Amazon Fire TV, Apple TV, game consoles, or older TVs without built-in smart features.

TAP A TILE, IT OPENS ON THE TV
Your streaming apps live on big tiles. Tap one and it opens on your TV in about a second. Build your wall from more than 100 apps and drag them into your own order.

A REMOTE THAT FEELS RIGHT
Swipe anywhere on the pad to move, tap to select. Back, Home and Menu are one tap away, plus play/pause, skip, a volume rocker you can hold, mute, input and power.

SCENES AND SLEEP TIMER
Run several steps with one tap, like turning the TV on and opening your movie app, or switching the TV and PC off at bedtime. Set a sleep timer and Couch Remote turns the TV off when it ends, or a notification lets you do it with one tap.

EVERY TV IN THE HOUSE
Add the living room Samsung, the bedroom Roku and the basement VIZIO, and switch between them with one tap. Moved a TV or changed your router? Couch Remote finds it again on its own.

TYPE ON YOUR TV
Search with your phone's keyboard instead of pecking at an on-screen grid.

YOUR PC, FROM THE COUCH
Install the free PC companion and your phone becomes a trackpad and keyboard for your Windows PC: move the mouse, scroll, type, control media and volume, open apps, and put it to sleep.

APPLE WATCH, SIRI AND CONTROL CENTER
Steer, change the volume with the Digital Crown and open apps from your Apple Watch. Ask Siri to set the volume, mute or open an app, and keep remote buttons in Control Center.

SET UP IN SECONDS
Couch Remote finds your TV on your Wi-Fi automatically. Depending on the TV you type the code it shows, choose Allow on the TV, or nothing at all. No TV nearby? Try the demo first.

FREE AND PRO
The full remote, the app launcher, the sleep timer and two scenes for one TV are free. Couch Remote Pro is a one-time purchase, with no subscription, that adds unlimited TVs, typing on your TV, the PC remote and unlimited scenes. Try every Pro feature free for 7 days. Bought Couch Remote when it was a paid app? Pro is already yours; if it doesn't show, tap Restore.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no servers. Couch Remote talks only to your TV and your PC, directly over your home network.

Couch Remote is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by VIZIO, Roku, Samsung, LG, Google or Microsoft. These names, and streaming service names, are trademarks of their owners and are used only to describe compatibility.

name: Couch Remote
reviewNotes:
No account or sign-in. Couch Remote controls VIZIO, Roku, Samsung, LG and Google TV / Android TV sets on the same Wi-Fi, and optionally a Windows PC running the free Couch Remote PC companion. Without a TV handy, tap 'No TV handy? Try the demo' on the first screen to explore every screen with pretend TVs; nothing is sent over the network in demo mode. Exit it from the ... menu.

Pro (one-time, com.troydunn.clicker.pro) unlocks more than one TV, typing on the TV and the PC remote; a free 7-day trial is offered as a $0 non-consumable (com.troydunn.clicker.trial). To see the paywall, open the PC remote, add a second TV, use the TV keyboard, or add more than the free number of scenes; Restore is on the same screen. People who bought the app while it was paid-upfront get Pro automatically.
